data.name: Galitea
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Galateia, which means 'maiden from Gala'. In Greek mythology, Galatea was a mountain nymph who was turned into stone by the god Zeus, who then fell in love with her. When she was revived, she became the first wife of Acis. This name is often used in Christian contexts to represent faithfulness, purity, and devotion.
